title: salvia pratensis var. sclareoides
intro: Salvia pratensis var. sclareoides, commonly known as Wood Betony, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and stress due to its health benefits of promoting relaxation and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Wood Betony include its sedative and anti-spasmodic effects, which can help to calm the nervous system and alleviate muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of Wood Betony include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
